risks.title: Structured-value match could be misread as source agreement
risks.mechanism: Comparison previously emitted a consistent-unverified state when structured values matched even if source excerpts differed.
risks.userEffect: A learner or judge could infer agreement that the source text did not establish.
risks.mitigation: Require excerpt-gated textual match, retain separate disagreement/unreviewed states, link and hash-bind the written source fixture.

risks.title: Evidence/source APIs could invoke ordinary JavaScript accessors
risks.mechanism: Direct property access and JSON serialization can invoke getter or toJSON code supplied by an in-process caller.
risks.userEffect: A supposedly data-only validation boundary could execute caller-defined JavaScript before rejection.
risks.mitigation: Inspect own data descriptors without invoking getters, reject unsafe descriptors/custom prototypes/sparse arrays, project primitive catalog fields and bound aggregate text.

risks.title: Literal retrieval used unnecessary agent orchestration
risks.mechanism: Simple exact wording retrieval traversed the delegated network even when deterministic catalog search was sufficient.
risks.userEffect: Higher latency/call count without measured retrieval benefit for literal lookup.
risks.mitigation: Expose direct zero-model lookup for literal source selection and reserve agent/model paths for tasks that need them.

risks.title: Historical metrics could silently survive material source changes
risks.mechanism: Progress prose stores source SHAs, but there was no machine path-to-evidence invalidation map.
risks.userEffect: A later candidate could accidentally quote benchmark or browser results measured on materially different code.
risks.mitigation: Revision-bound metric registry plus fail-closed change-impact classification and a PR artifact listing affected suites and stale metrics.

risks.title: Held-out semantic evaluation is not human adjudicated
risks.mechanism: Engineering-v1 is public development data and therefore unsuitable as independent held-out semantic evidence.
risks.userEffect: Quoting it as final accuracy would overstate evidence quality and permit test-set leakage.
risks.mitigation: Blind neutral-ID review/freeze protocol is implemented; no human-reviewed set is claimed.
risks.unblockCondition: Create and human-review the real 20/10/10 set against designated source material, freeze it before final prompt tuning, then run the recorded live model.

risks.title: Original rights-cleared lesson and reviewed written guide are missing
risks.mechanism: Current learner content is explicitly synthetic and cannot establish real source provenance or semantic support.
risks.userEffect: The core demo cannot truthfully claim real educational evidence or final comparison quality.
risks.mitigation: Synthetic fixtures remain clearly labeled and are never represented as the original lesson.
risks.unblockCondition: Provide rights-cleared original lesson/video, written guide and human factual review evidence.

risks.title: Live funded provider economics are unmeasured
risks.mechanism: Provider tests use synthetic transport; actual tokens, price basis, run cost and judge-budget reserve are unknown.
risks.userEffect: A public judge path could fail or spend unpredictably even though quota mechanics pass synthetic tests.
risks.mitigation: Quota, concurrency, kill switch and no-retry behavior are implemented; paid inference remains disabled.
risks.unblockCondition: Approve provider/budget, run a small capped live sample, record exact model/token/price basis and preserve judging reserve.

risks.title: Physical touch and human screen-reader acceptance are untested
risks.mechanism: Desktop/headless engines and automated accessibility checks cannot reproduce physical touch hardware or human assistive-technology use.
risks.userEffect: Mobile or assistive users may encounter blockers not visible in CI.
risks.mitigation: Automated keyboard, zoom, target-size, captions and multi-engine checks are explicitly labeled as non-physical evidence.
risks.unblockCondition: Run the core journey on an available physical iPhone/Android device and complete human screen-reader acceptance.

risks.title: Independent public caller/peer interoperability is unproven
risks.mechanism: Neutral-consumer and peer tests are same-owner/local synthetic origins rather than independently operated public HTTPS sites.
risks.userEffect: Challenge interoperability claims would exceed observed evidence.
risks.mitigation: Exact-name resolution, CORS, consent, denial and cross-origin behavior are tested locally without claiming outside adoption.
risks.unblockCondition: Obtain authorized public HTTPS caller/peer evidence and outside builder runs after release gates permit it.

risks.title: Production Cloudflare request and billing headroom are incomplete
risks.mechanism: Read-only account observation lacks Billing Read and no SUTRA production-domain request sample exists.
risks.userEffect: Production capacity/cost claims could be wrong despite static routing design.
risks.mitigation: Static assets are designed outside Worker-first API paths; no production capacity claim is made.
risks.unblockCondition: Obtain authorized billing/headroom evidence and a dated production request sample after deployment gates open.

risks.title: Local lexical retrieval silently dropped query constraints and alternate matches
risks.mechanism: Partial coverage, discarded short/long terms and phrase score thresholds could hide a required term or competing exact source cue.
risks.userEffect: Learners could receive an apparently specific single excerpt despite unmatched constraints or alternative excerpts.
risks.mitigation: Require full retained term coverage, refuse oversized terms, preserve single-character terms, report ambiguity across all fully matching cues with a five-receipt cap. Semantic review remains separate.

risks.title: Stream terminal reason and token usage could be overwritten
risks.mechanism: A second empty finish frame could replace an incomplete finish, while later or arithmetically inconsistent usage could be treated as final.
risks.userEffect: An incomplete answer could appear completed or untrustworthy usage could drive cost reporting.
risks.mitigation: Reject post-finish choices, repeated/early usage and inconsistent token arithmetic; fail incomplete with no retry. Real-engine compatibility and economics remain open.

risks.title: Backend identity drift after learner approval
risks.mechanism: Same model name/backend type could point at a replaced gateway or changed credentials or limits.
risks.userEffect: Approval could silently transfer to a different inference configuration.
risks.mitigation: Opaque per-request configuration precondition; reject mismatches before quota/upstream. Does not attest remote model weights. Bind source quota/content and freeze consent before discovery.

risks.title: Cancellation during a later inference preflight erases completed evidence
risks.mechanism: The old output was cleared before the first new model request.
risks.userEffect: A cancelled preflight could destroy the learner's previous valid result.
risks.mitigation: Delay clearing to actual model attempt; keep run epoch and stale action guards. Permanently revoke earlier action authority after edit or rediscovery.

risks.title: Release candidate can inherit stale evidence or unexpected files
risks.mechanism: Incomplete source/content binding and unfiltered historical graph files could survive candidate materialization.
risks.userEffect: An apparently consistent package could carry stale or unintended public artifacts.
risks.mitigation: Exact revision/content and byte checks; public path allowlist; actual quota validation; trusted stable source tree. Independent live gates remain. Require intended publication files and exact path map; omit private references and unbound annotations.

risks.title: Mutable or cancelled source operation crosses async boundary
risks.mechanism: Caller arguments could change during handshake; delayed source results could arrive after abort/timeout.
risks.userEffect: Unapproved query or stale receipt enters the run.
risks.mitigation: Snapshot descriptor-safe primitive arguments before await; preabort and post-await checks; preserve terminal timeout/cancellation reason.

risks.title: Provider interpretation inherits invalid receipt
risks.mechanism: Receipt observer errors could be swallowed at transport/runtime boundary, allowing apparent completion.
risks.userEffect: Learner sees an interpretation without reliable catalog-matched evidence.
risks.mitigation: Independent final collector snapshot and catalog revalidation; sticky invalidity; reject completion and preserve only valid partial receipts.

risks.title: Detached source action or query drift
risks.mechanism: Old controls could retain action authority or overwrite current status; media remount could lose the typed query.
risks.userEffect: Incorrect action or lost learner context.
risks.mitigation: Check connected/current epoch, reject stale completions, preserve raw query, validate native duration before enabling actions.

risks.title: Ambiguous or coercible content identity
risks.mechanism: Multiple sources could be paired with one media/transcript; substring digest or regex coercion could accept misleading identity or execute conversion hooks.
risks.userEffect: Wrong source binding or unexpected executable behavior.
risks.mitigation: Require single bound source, exact segment, strict string validation and final cancellation check.

risks.title: Navigation lifecycle authority drift
risks.mechanism: Late discovery could re-enable stale inference approval; pagehide could destroy retained local evidence.
risks.userEffect: Unexpected inference permission or broken return navigation.
risks.mitigation: Revoke operation epoch and provider contract, abort stale async work and keep local media paused for persisted pagehide.

risks.title: False-positive native cue seek
risks.mechanism: A one-second tolerance could certify a timestamp before or outside a short cue.
risks.userEffect: Learner sees a source-seek success not supported by playback.
risks.mitigation: Finite half-open interval and bounded start offset; verify source identity and independently reject wrong cue landing.

risks.title: Ambiguous destructive local review outcome
risks.mechanism: Storage changes may precede a thrown exception; two-key clear is not atomic.
risks.userEffect: Definite refusal or stale export may misrepresent deleted records.
risks.mitigation: Classify post-effect failures unknown, refresh storage and invalidate affected action evidence; no replay.

risks.title: Rejected provider response body or late 409 callback
risks.mechanism: Binding rejects before downstream stream ownership; aborted transport may still settle.
risks.userEffect: Unconsumed stream or stale UI state.
risks.mitigation: Dispose rejected/late bodies and guard callbacks with cancellation; exact ingress and no ambient credentials. Extend exact disposal to browser adapter and Worker upstream response ownership before cancellation recheck; known quota lease released once.

risks.title: Genuine history restoration not yet observed
risks.mechanism: Synthetic pagehide and a real history reload cannot establish BFCache eligibility or restored media behavior.
risks.userEffect: Stale local rows or authority may survive a browser freeze.
risks.mitigation: Refresh local state on native persisted pageshow. Actual full Chromium restored original document twice, with and without existing media; verified storage drift, no stale review authority and retained paused blob. Other engines' BFCache eligibility is not asserted.

risks.title: Mutable source authority at final provider evidence collector
risks.mechanism: Matching only a caller-mutable current catalog could mint newly forged receipts.
risks.userEffect: Completed or partial model interpretation could carry changed source evidence.
risks.mitigation: Match immutable original catalog and current validity independently; new negative unit test; full integration required.

risks.title: Superseded native seek or late written-source verification
risks.mechanism: Multiple UI entry points could observe a newer seek's timestamp or stale guide response after navigation.
risks.userEffect: An obsolete action could report a source cue reached or written source match.
risks.mitigation: One active native seek owner, abort superseded operations, source identity recheck, explicit comparison action revocation on navigation/mode change. Cancellation does not undo an already-applied native seek.

risks.title: Pre-admission request-body chunk overhead
risks.mechanism: Array of chunks retained independently of byte ceiling; zero-length chunks and many small chunks increase memory; cancellation could leave reader locked.
risks.userEffect: Resource pressure or unavailable requests before quota.
risks.mitigation: Single bounded byte buffer, abort recheck before read, fatal UTF-8 and unconditional reader cleanup.

risks.title: Ambiguous quota admission after response loss
risks.mechanism: Durable Object may commit reserve before lost/cancelled response reveals generated lease ID. Worker cannot release unknown ID; active slot may remain until 45-second expiry.
risks.userEffect: Transient concurrency denial; daily reservation charges remain conservative.
risks.mitigation: UTC-day and admission deadline bound to request and rechecked within transaction; lost-response cancellation never contacts upstream or refunds/replays; real local SQLite DO confirms 45-second expiry. Deployed service and cost evidence remain separate gates.

risks.title: SSE buffering and terminal lease ordering
risks.mechanism: Buffered frames can continue after abort; eager drain ignores downstream demand; DONE may precede lease teardown.
risks.userEffect: Memory/resource pressure or apparent success after cancellation.
risks.mitigation: Bound frames/bytes; pull-driven stream, abort checks and bounded cleanup.

risks.title: Server redirect mode incompatible with Workerd
risks.mechanism: Browser-supported redirect:error throws in Workerd.
risks.userEffect: All legitimate reservations fail in actual runtime.
risks.mitigation: Server manual mode with explicit response status/identity refusal; real local runtime regression.

risks.title: Portable route missing at Pages boundary
risks.mechanism: Published API path not in exact ingress allowlist; late service replies can retain body.
risks.userEffect: Portable client fails or stale reply leaks resources.
risks.mitigation: Exact alias and query parity; abort-safe late body ownership.

risks.title: Peer path interpreted as another authority
risks.mechanism: URL construction treats authority-like pathname as a network-relative reference.
risks.userEffect: Wrong peer origin could inherit consent/private context.
risks.mitigation: Assign pathname on the already parsed target and assert origin/path.

risks.title: Save exception misclassified as rejection
risks.mechanism: Storage may commit before native-looking exception; duplicate completion may refer to changed record.
risks.userEffect: Misleading rejection, replay or wrong success.
risks.mitigation: Exact unchanged readback or unknown; immutable bounded identity and no replay.

risks.title: Verified native media/track source drift
risks.mechanism: Native element may change source/track after initial verification.
risks.userEffect: Cue/seek success on substituted media.
risks.mitigation: Pin exact source/track identities; revoke/dispose, transcript-only and explicit retry.

risks.title: Saved-review export races
risks.mechanism: Queued export can target a changed record or report success after navigation or cross-tab invalidation.
risks.userEffect: Wrong or stale record download/outcome.
risks.mitigation: Serialize export using the cooperative mutation lock; revalidate record and revoke view epoch.

risks.title: Incomplete SSE event and JSON media-type lookalikes
risks.mechanism: Line-level parsing could certify an unterminated or named-error terminal; prefix media type admitted lookalikes.
risks.userEffect: False completion or unwanted admission.
risks.mitigation: Require complete bounded SSE event with blank-line delimiter; exact JSON media-type match before body/quota/provider contact.

risks.title: Stale seek owner keeps waiting after result authority is revoked.
risks.mechanism: Stale seek owner keeps waiting after result authority is revoked.
risks.userEffect: Incorrect, stale or unavailable user-visible evidence and interactions.
risks.mitigation: Cancel outstanding waits, preserve explicit fresh action; cannot undo physical seek already applied.

risks.title: Asynchronous remount steals keyboard focus or loses query selection.
risks.mechanism: Asynchronous remount steals keyboard focus or loses query selection.
risks.userEffect: Incorrect, stale or unavailable user-visible evidence and interactions.
risks.mitigation: Capture/restore focused controls only; restore explicit load focus on invalidation. Physical/screen-reader tests remain open.

risks.title: Compact UTF-16 budgeting underestimates downloadable bytes; repeated tail scans waste CPU; caller array metadata may execute.
risks.mechanism: Compact UTF-16 budgeting underestimates downloadable bytes; repeated tail scans waste CPU; caller array metadata may execute.
risks.userEffect: Incorrect, stale or unavailable user-visible evidence and interactions.
risks.mitigation: Own descriptors, bounded prefixes and actual formatted UTF-8 budget; binary-search monotonic balanced prefix. Trusted labels and no executable Proxy sandbox claim.

risks.title: Nonempty 202 treated as valid acknowledgement; one-byte held stream delays failure.
risks.mechanism: Nonempty 202 treated as valid acknowledgement; one-byte held stream delays failure.
risks.userEffect: Incorrect, stale or unavailable user-visible evidence and interactions.
risks.mitigation: Require zero-byte EOF; malformed response cancels reader, cannot progress discovery. Restricted stateless JSON-only MCP profile, not general SSE support.

risks.title: Byte-budget bypass via empty or tiny stream fragments
risks.mechanism: Unlimited zero-byte chunks and microtask-only reads can starve deadlines; repeated races against one unresolved cancellation promise can retain reactions.
risks.userEffect: CPU/memory pressure or delayed cancellation, including pre-admission Worker requests.
risks.mitigation: Patch committed: cap empty fragments at 256, large content fragments at 131072, yield every 1024 reads or SSE lines; per-read abort race. Exact CI 19/19, including Workerd.

risks.title: Native playback left running on history restoration
risks.mechanism: Browser freeze during active playback could leave an old operation or media state implicitly active.
risks.userEffect: Potential stale evidence, privacy leakage or failed learner operation.
risks.mitigation: Actual Chromium same-document restored while playing, paused on return; no cross-browser BFCache claim.

risks.title: Stale queued local review outcome
risks.mechanism: A queued lock operation can settle after pagehide and overwrite fresh status or attempt download.
risks.userEffect: Potential stale evidence, privacy leakage or failed learner operation.
risks.mitigation: All review outcome presentation epochs revoked at navigation, cooperative lock and no mutation replay.

risks.title: Hash-consistent but uninspectable written derivative
risks.mechanism: Fragment parsing can omit hidden wrapper attributes; source path normalization or claim size mismatch can misrepresent evidence.
risks.userEffect: Potential stale evidence, privacy leakage or failed learner operation.
risks.mitigation: Shared canonical derivative and canonical URLs, exact bytes and metadata, no original-source truth or arbitrary HTML sanitizer claim.

risks.title: Ambient request metadata outside consent contract
risks.mechanism: Default referrer can reveal caller URL and arbitrary adapter headers can carry private data.
risks.userEffect: Potential stale evidence, privacy leakage or failed learner operation.
risks.mitigation: Explicit no-referrer, fixed provider headers, credentialless approved contacts. CORS Origin is a normal transport requirement, not hidden identity.

risks.title: Partial or dynamic MCP discovery represented as complete
risks.mechanism: A tools/list response can contain the expected tool(s) plus a pagination cursor, while a dynamic tools capability can announce unsupported list-change semantics.
risks.userEffect: A partial tool catalog may be represented as a verified fixed read-only capability; malformed discovery may fail inconsistently.
risks.mitigation: Refuse pagination, malformed entries and dynamic external capabilities; retain narrow fixed schemas and separate approval.

risks.title: Viewer mutates canonical runtime trace or receives post-settlement events
risks.mechanism: Canonical stored event shared with observer; trace listener retained after settlement.
risks.userEffect: Misleading execution evidence, injected fields or stale UI updates.
risks.mitigation: Freeze scalar event, detach observer on settlement, reject closed-run events.

risks.title: Adapter identity changes after run admission
risks.mechanism: Mutable model object mode and callable read again after asynchronous entry or viewer callback.
risks.userEffect: Scripted output can be mislabelled as provider output or invoke an unintended adapter.
risks.mitigation: Pin original callable, mode and model name at admission; keep receiver binding.

risks.title: Mutable host contact dispatch changes between approvals
risks.mechanism: A viewer or first contact can replace peer runtime inspector/transport or mutable inspector perform property before the next separately consented operation.
risks.userEffect: Unexpected artifact contact or disclosure despite the original decision policy.
risks.mitigation: Pin original callable and receiver, and immutable admitted peer transport. Use original consent state for actual approvals and revocation.

risks.title: Private grant metadata can execute before policy admission
risks.mechanism: URL coercion, grant property getters and arbitrary array iteration occur while processing caller-owned private-context grants.
risks.userEffect: Unexpected side effects before admission or inconsistent exact grant interpretation.
risks.mitigation: Bound primitive URL, own enumerable data descriptors, dense ordinary arrays and reserved field rejection before admission.

risks.title: Distinct capabilities alias one model-facing tool
risks.mechanism: Pinned runner safeName normalizes and truncates paths; duplicate labels overwrite dispatch table entries.
risks.userEffect: A model may select one apparent capability while dispatch binds another.
risks.mitigation: Preflight exact pinned naming for all references and reject duplicate labels; recheck model-bound tool table.
risks.unblockCondition: Exact adversarial collision and positive runtime/browser regressions pass.

risks.title: Model adapter mutates canonical history or tool validation schema
risks.mechanism: Runner passes shared messages and schema references; adapter transformations could widen validation or pollute future prompts.
risks.userEffect: Incorrect tool arguments or conversation evidence may be accepted.
risks.mitigation: Detach offered history and schema; validate against canonical tool-name/schema map.
risks.unblockCondition: Exact schema mutation and multi-step isolation regressions pass.

risks.title: Parent synthesizes completed answer after child exhaustion
risks.mechanism: Pinned runner returns empty child text on step exhaustion or budget skip as a normal tool response; host only checked top-level final text.
risks.userEffect: A misleading completed answer and extra model spend after a failed dependency.
risks.mitigation: Abort host on observed incomplete child or composition-limit trace, preserving prior failure authority.
risks.unblockCondition: Exact local/peer child exhaustion, no-extra-call and normal runtime/browser checks pass.
